name: Market Data Streamer
description: Acquires real-time price data for a watchlist of tickers via yfinance polling. Wires into the shared MarketDataStream. Emits per-ticker price ticks every 2s.
typical_use: Always run first for any ticker analysis task

name: Economic Data Scheduler
description: Fetches 15 key economic indicators from FRED and BLS on a schedule. Monitors release calendar. Provides macro context for all analysis agents. Caches results for 1 hour.
typical_use: Run once at session start; re-run on economic event releases

name: Technical Analyst Agent
description: Runs 25+ TA indicators (RSI, MACD, Bollinger, EMA, ATR, OBV, Stochastic, etc.) on streaming OHLCV data. Generates a composite bull/bear signal score and a local-LLM signal narrative. Produces structured training samples.
typical_use: Run after MarketDataStreamer; feeds TraderAgent and BullBearDebateAgent

name: News Sentiment Agent
description: Aggregates headlines from RSS feeds and NewsAPI. Scores per-ticker and market-wide sentiment using keyword heuristics (-1 to +1). Classifies news by category (crypto, macro, earnings, M&A, energy). Produces training samples of headline → sentiment label pairs.
typical_use: Run in parallel with TechnicalAnalyst; feeds TraderAgent and BullBearDebateAgent

name: Fundamental Analyst Agent
description: Pulls SEC EDGAR XBRL financial data (revenue, net income, EPS, assets, equity) and Polygon ticker details. Computes P/E, P/B, profit margin, ROE, revenue growth. Generates an investment thesis via local LLM.
typical_use: Run for equity research tasks; use depth='full' for complete EDGAR data

name: Forecasting Agent
description: Time-series price forecasting using ARIMA(2,1,2), Random Forest regression, and naive drift. Auto-selects best model by RMSE. Outputs multi-step forecast with 95% confidence intervals. All computation is local.
typical_use: Run after TechnicalAnalyst; feeds BullBearDebateAgent and TraderAgent

name: Bull/Bear Debate Agent
description: Runs a structured 3-call Ollama debate: Bull analyst argues the long case, Bear analyst argues the short case, Referee delivers a BUY/SELL/HOLD verdict with confidence score. Derived from TradingAgents multi-agent architecture.
typical_use: Run after all analysis agents; feeds TraderAgent

name: Trader Agent
description: Synthesises TA (35%), sentiment (20%), forecast (25%), and debate (20%) into a weighted composite score. Generates BUY/SELL/HOLD/SCALE signal with entry price, stop loss, and take profit levels. Produces structured training samples of multi-factor → trade decision.
typical_use: Run after BullBearDebateAgent; output feeds RiskManagerAgent

name: Risk Manager Agent
description: Gate-keeper for all trade signals. Applies: ATR-based position sizing (1% max risk/trade), Kelly criterion adjustment, max 10% concentration limit, 15% portfolio drawdown gate, and minimum 1:1 R:R filter. Computes VaR(95%) and VaR(99%). Issues APPROVED/REJECTED verdict.
typical_use: Always the final step in any trade pipeline — nothing executes without approval

name: Weather Impact Agent
description: Fetches weather for 5 major financial/agricultural hubs. Classifies conditions (severe, winter storm, drought, heat wave, hurricane, flood). Maps to commodity market impacts with price direction signals. Covers natural gas, crude oil, corn, soybeans, wheat, insurance, utilities.
typical_use: Run in parallel with economic/sentiment agents for commodity and energy tasks
